profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Anthony and I'm a software engineer currently working in the cybersecurity space. I'm passionate about creating tools and products that leverage technology for good. I have many interests inside of computing, ask me about them! I'm excited by simple solutions, clean design, and thoughtful code.

Outside of computing, I enjoy aviation, photography, cycling, reading, and other hobbies. I'm always looking for ways to take my learnings from these hobbies and apply them to my work. I believe inspiration can be found in unexpected places.

positions.title: Software Engineer 4; Application Networking & Security
positions.description: Skills: Java · Python · Go · SQL · Kubernetes · Docker · Computer Networking · Network Security · Databases · Protocol Buffers

positions.title: Software Engineer 3; Application Networking & Security
positions.description:
-  Rearchitect and implement Network Threat Analytics feature to accommodate twice the scale while using less resources on average. The new design makes it much easier to onboard new threat detectors to the feature
-  Work directly with QE team to enhance the way we perform scale testing for our product leading to more realistic testing scenarios and better outcomes for our customers and sales motion
-  Pursue improved customer experience by facilitating collaborations between Solution Engineer (SE) and engineering teams
-  Lead a team of three junior engineers across multiple verticals and mentor them in software design, bug triaging, testing, and other disciplines

positions.title: Software Engineer 3; Networking & Security Business Unit
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
-  Develop a fully functional proof of concept LLM integration for our product that serves as a single pane of glass for the user to correlate security events happening within their datacenter. Demo was showcased by our CIO and VP to customers at multiple conferences with great feedback
-  Lead a cross-functional team of PMs, SEs, and other engineers to design a novel way for customers to discover and validate optimal distributed-firewall rules in a scaleable way
-  Member of the hiring panel and accelerated onboarding for new hires, enabling them to contribute to the product sooner after joining

positions.title: Software Engineer 2; Networking & Security Business Unit
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
-  Design and implement machine learning pipeline framework for the product, enabling additional ML powered features
-  Scale ML feature creation by moving the processing out of the API critical path, allowing for ML complexity to scale independently of API response time
-  Framework and ML code tested and run at scale of hundreds of millions of network flows and ten thousand hosts

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern; Networking & Security Business Unit
positions.description:
-    Research and implement cutting edge unsupervised machine learning techniques to cluster workloads in customer environments
-    Enable actionable insights for customers related to their data center security posture by integrating the above work into visualization, recommendation, and security features

positions.title: Privacy Engineering Intern; Chief Data Privacy Office
positions.description:
- Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure personal data is properly collected, processed, stored, and destroyed
- Automate, scale, and document the way Cisco creates essential privacy communications for customers
- Design and produce Privacy Data Maps so that customers can better understand how Cisco handles their data
positions.insights: Skills: Data Privacy · Python · Privacy Policies

positions.title: Programming Mentor
positions.description:
-    Mentor middle school aged kids through programming projects in both Java and Python languages
-    Tutor students through AP level concepts, like data structures and object oriented programming
-    Help students use graphics libraries, allowing them to make their own games in Java or Python

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern; Networking & Security Buisness Unit
positions.description:
-    Create new REST APIs for the NSX management plane, allowing for more thorough data collection and stronger insights into customer networks and systems
-    Develop a portion of the front end for my team’s feature using Angular and TypeScript, enable a cleaner and more intuitive experience for the user
-    Participate in Jamz, an internal two day hackathon, collaborate with professionals from around the world to build an easier way for vmware engineers to find the root of customer issues using NLP

positions.title: Technical Intern; Business Intelligence and Information Security
positions.description:
-    Optimize workflows for finance team by analyzing aircraft direct operating cost data, focusing on the efficiency and automation of key processes using SQL
-    Increase usability and reduced query time from minutes to seconds of flight data business objects report by migrating it to tableau, providing more real time access to logistical information
-    Secure critical systems identifying and mitigating information risks through penetration testing and access management

honors.title: Graduate Honorable Mention in Engineering Award
honors.description: This award honors graduate students who have attained top performance upon graduation
honors.issuer: Issued by Santa Clara University · Jun 2022

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by Santa Clara University · Jun 2020

volunteerExperiences.description: As a rider I raised funds to support cancer research at The Ohio State University comprehensive cancer center.
